invariant_bindings.invariant_text: A call MUST NEVER be retried unless it is marked idempotent or the policy has requires_idempotency set to False by an explicit operator decision.
The total retry attempts MUST NEVER exceed budget_ratio of successful traffic in the trailing window.
Backoff intervals SHALL include jitter in the range [0, jitter * base_interval] to prevent synchronized retry storms.
Retries CANNOT be issued when the governing TimeoutBudget.remaining_ms is less than or equal to zero.
A retry policy SHALL classify errors as retryable, non-retryable, or fatal and NEVER retry a non-retryable or fatal error.
